description: This file defines an enumeration 'AllowedSolution' in the 'org.apache.commons.math3.analysis.solvers' package, specifying the types of solutions accepted by bracketing univariate root-finding algorithms, particularly in the context of numerical analysis or mathematical problem solving.

classes.name: AllowedSolution
classes.description: An enumeration that specifies which solutions are acceptable in root-finding algorithms, controlling whether solutions can be under-approximations, over-approximations, or solutions satisfying certain value constraints.
